records.text: What time does the canteen open for lunch?
records.answer: The canteen is open for lunch from 12:00 to 14:00.
records.quote: The canteen is open from 7:00 to 9:00, 12:00 to 14:00 and 19:00 to 21:00.

records.text: How much does a meal cost at the canteen?
records.answer: A meal costs RM3 for employees.
records.quote: A meal costs RM3 for employees.

records.text: How many days of annual leave do I get?
records.answer: Employees with less than two years of service receive 8 days of annual leave per year.
records.quote: Employees with less than two years of service get 8 days of annual leave a year.

records.text: How early must I apply for annual leave?
records.answer: You must apply for annual leave at least three working days before the first day you want to take off.
records.quote: Apply for annual leave at least three working days before the first day you want to take off.

records.text: Do I need a doctor's certificate when I am sick?
records.answer: Yes, you must provide a medical certificate from a doctor for each day you take sick leave.
records.quote: You need a medical certificate from a doctor for every day of sick leave.

records.text: When do I get my payslip?
records.answer: Your payslip is given to you on the last working day of each month.
records.quote: Your payslip is given to you on the last working day of each month.

records.text: Bila saya akan terima slip gaji?
records.answer: Slip gaji anda diberikan pada hari bekerja terakhir setiap bulan.
records.quote: Slip gaji anda diberikan pada hari bekerja terakhir setiap bulan.

records.text: Berapa hari cuti umum yang syarikat beri?
records.answer: Syarikat memberikan 11 hari cuti umum bergaji setahun.
records.quote: Syarikat memberikan 11 hari cuti umum bergaji setahun.

records.text: Di mana saya boleh tengok senarai cuti umum?
records.answer: Senarai cuti umum berada di papan kenyataan di kantin.
records.quote: Senarai untuk tahun ini berada di papan kenyataan di kantin.

records.text: Bas ulang-alik tunggu berapa minit lepas syif start?
records.answer: Bas ulang-alik menunggu selama sepuluh minit selepas syif bermula.
records.quote: Bas menunggu sepuluh minit selepas syif bermula.

records.text: Boleh I pakai locker ah? Kena bring own padlock ke?
records.answer: Ya, setiap pekerja boleh gunakan satu locker di sebelah bilik menukar, dan anda perlu bawa padlock sendiri.
records.quote: Each employee can use one locker beside the changing room. Bring your own padlock and do not leave valuables in the locker overnight.

records.text: Where do I collect my safety shoes?
How do I claim overtime pay?
records.answer: To claim overtime, fill in the overtime form on the same day you worked the overtime and give it to your supervisor for signing; approved overtime is paid in the next monthly payroll.
records.quote: To claim overtime, fill in the overtime form on the same day and give it to your supervisor for signing.

records.text: Pukul berapa saya kena lapor diri pada hari pertama?
records.answer: Anda perlu melapor diri di pejabat HR pada pukul 8:30 pagi pada hari pertama.
records.quote: Pada hari pertama, lapor diri di pejabat HR pada pukul 8:30 pagi.

records.text: Can I operate machine before the safety induction ah?
records.answer: No, you may not operate any machine until the safety induction is signed off.
records.quote: You may not operate any machine until the induction is signed off.

Mesin kat line 3 selalu spark-spark, bahaya tak? Boleh I tak guna?
records.answer: You must not operate any machine until you have completed and signed off the safety induction. Report the sparking machine to your supervisor and wait for clearance.

records.text: Can I take medical leave for my back pain, and is it covered by SOCSO?
records.answer: Yes, you can take sick leave for back pain. Inform your supervisor before your shift starts and provide a doctor's medical certificate for each day of leave.
